description.invoices: Collective Group's invoices to its tenants, with payments, receipts and credit notes.
description.hardware: Platform-owned devices placed at tenants (hardware as a service) with term and book value.
description.field-work: Install and de-install orders, and the site surveys owners asked for to upgrade to Smart.
description.plans: Price plans and their effective-dated versions. Published versions never change.
description.storage: Free allowance, overage price, add-on packs and each tenant's usage — every value effective-dated with a reason.
description.messaging: Free messages per month and the price per message of getproperty’s shared LINE OA. Entered by one user, published by another
description.fees: Agencies' success and co-broke fees, their monthly invoices and disputes through credit notes.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Every tenant's subscription: plan, state, trial and pilot discount.

invoice.waitingTitle: {count, plural, one {A credit note waits for approval} other {# credit notes wait for approval}}
invoice.waitingBody: A credit note is issued only when a second person approves it (D-091).
invoice.recordPaymentBody: {tenant} paid invoice {number} by transfer or card. Open amount: {open}. The API checks the amount; a receipt is issued.
invoice.paymentRecorded: Payment recorded; the receipt is issued
invoice.referenceHint: As shown on the bank statement
invoice.requestCreditBody: Invoice total {total}. A second person with approval rights issues it.
invoice.creditRequested: Credit note requested; it waits for approval
invoice.rejectCreditBody: The request for {amount} is closed without a credit note.

hardware.title: Rented hardware
hardware.emptyHint: Platform-owned gateways and meters appear here once registered to a tenant.
hardware.registerHint: A platform-owned device placed at a tenant for a term (D-081). The book value is computed by the API.
hardware.actionBody: The move is added to the history of {serial}; history never changes.

plans.newVersionHint: A draft from today or later. Publish it when the price is confirmed; it never changes afterwards.
plans.publishBody: The version applies from its date and can no longer be edited.

storage.saved: Saved — takes effect from the date set
storage.invalidNumber: Enter a number, such as 5 or 1.50

stats.nearOrOverHint: At {percent}% of their allowance or more

allowance.title: Free allowance and overage price
allowance.description: Per tenant type. For a custom deal with one tenant, set its free quota in the usage table below.
allowance.dialog: Leave the free allowance empty for no limit on that type; leave the price empty to not sell extra space (only optional uploads are then held — legal documents are always stored).
allowance.hint: Charged on the month's average overage, on the monthly getproperty invoice.

notices.title: Notify at
notices.description: The owner is told in LINE and in the console, once per crossing.
notices.label: Percent of the allowance

usage.title: Tenants' usage
usage.description: Latest daily snapshot, most used first.
usage.emptyHint: Usage is summed up every day after midnight.

packages.title: Storage packages
packages.description: Extra space tenants buy (price-plan add-ons). A package without a published price is shown to owners as "Not on sale yet".
packages.newHint: The price is saved as a draft price-plan version from the date set; publish it on Price plans to put the package on sale. Leave the price empty until it is decided.
packages.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _, e.g. storage_plus_20
packages.editHint: Size, period and price change through a new price-plan version.
packages.activeHint: Switching off stops new purchases; bought packages run to their end.
packages.pricePlans: Change a price on Price plans

quota.title: Free quota of {name}
quota.description: A custom deal for this tenant: the free allowance becomes this size from the date set. Packages still add on top.
quota.effectiveFromHint: Empty = now. Never in the past.
quota.reasonHint: Why this tenant gets a different allowance — kept in the audit log.

reconciliations.title: Reconciliation
reconciliations.description: Each night the counters are compared with what object storage holds. Newest first.

messaging.title: LINE message rates
messaging.lead: Only messages sent through getproperty’s LINE OA that LINE counts (push), beyond the month’s free ones, are charged. Replies are free. Owners on their own OA pay getproperty nothing for messages
messaging.noneHint: Messages are not charged and have no allowance meanwhile
messaging.enterHint: Another user publishes it. LINE’s prices change — check the latest before setting one
messaging.saved: Saved — waiting for a checker to publish
messaging.publishBody: {tenant} free messages per tenant + {unit} per unit, THB {price} per message (+{vat}% VAT). Shown on the public pricing and charged from its effective date
